notes.title: April Fools Update!
notes.content:
It's April 1st, and Five Nights at Restroom 2 gets its first content update!

The first update is a bit smaller, but we're already working on two bigger updates with content that was cut from the game. (Like the two minigames City Pooper Pigeon and Hunt Down The Hawk You may have wondered why the tracks City Pooper Pigeon and Hunt Down The Hawk from the soundtrack aren't in the game. That's because they are from those minigames, but don't worry, we're working on it, along with a third update.) So, in total, there will be three content updates.

Today's update includes:

A mysterious crowbar on the floor of Night 4
2 New Achievements
Price reduction of the base game.
